messages.body:
The referral has been entered into our scheduling system and a team member will reach out to the patient today or the next business day.  

For your records, the patient ID is PRE1068808.  Please use this for all future communications.


We will also send them a text shortly letting them know to call us in case we miss them when we reach out.


The patient is welcome to call our direct scheduling line M-F 8am to 5pm @ 818-629-1169


Once we can schedule them and they complete their exam, reports are typically sent out within 24-72 hours.

Patients can also view their appointment times, answer prescreening questions and sign all liens here:
https://precise.radflow360.com/patient-portal
 
If this is also a personal injury case:
 
  • A report containing the findings of the exam will also be sent to the attorney
  • A bill will be sent to the attorney once both the patient and the attorney sign all pending liens
  • Please make sure to submit a negotiation offer before sending the payment
 
 
Access bills, appointment times, and e-sign liens​  (Click request login if you don't have an account)

Access reports & images  (Request login here for reports)
